description: This file defines a PHP class 'Menu' within the OpenCart framework, specifically within the admin module for managing menu entities. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving menu records and their descriptions in a database, indicating that it's a data access layer for menu management functionality.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Represents the menu management model in OpenCart's admin system, providing CRUD operations for menu records and their descriptions, interfacing with the database.

methods.name: addMenu
methods.description: Creates a new menu record in the database and adds descriptions for each language.

methods.name: editMenu
methods.description: Updates an existing menu record and its descriptions based on menu ID.

methods.name: deleteMenu
methods.description: Deletes a menu record and its descriptions by menu ID, and updates child menus if necessary.

methods.name: deleteMenuByCode
methods.description: Deletes one or more menu records identified by their code.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific menu by its ID.

methods.name: getMenuByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a menu record by its code.

methods.name: getMenus
methods.description: Returns all menu records, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getTotalMenus
methods.description: Counts total menu records in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a menu for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a menu.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language across menus.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific menu.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all menu descriptions in a specific language.
